message.content: {"ranking": [], "explanation": "The discovery trace shows drop_frame misfiring (cycles 13\u201314) and output corruption at cycle 16 (tdata=1 vs 6, tlast=0 vs 1, tvalid=0 vs 1). This points to two coupled failures: (1) rst must clear the frame-drop machinery (drop_frame and wr_ptr_cur), which currently only zeroes wr_ptr; (2) the drop-frame logic at line 100 tests (full|full_cur|drop_frame) but should only activate when the FIFO is actually full\u2014the predicate is missing a !full_cur guard that prevents spurious drop_frame assertion when wr_ptr_cur has wrapped but wr_ptr has not. Patch 06b184d83718 resets the missing state in the rst block (line 99) and patch c388b437f780 adds the !full_cur qualification at the tlast decision (line 103). Together they address the observed reset-flush and false-drop symptoms; other candidates either gate on unrelated signals or invert the needed polarity. Both patches edit the displayed file at the cited lines and no others, so the check budget is satisfied with these two."}
